task: De novo design of bio-inspired adhesive hydrogels by predicting adhesive strength from 6-monomer compositions, then exploring composition space to push adhesion above 1 MPa underwater.
primary_target_for_optimization: Glass (kPa)_max (max of 10s/60s on glass), to be compared with 1000 kPa = 1 MPa threshold
named_methods: Bayesian optimization with Expected Improvement (EI) acquisition
RFR-GP / RFR-RFR / GP-GP variants from the source paper
validation: Use the multi-round (1,2,3) experimental results in ML_ei&pred (1&2&3rounds)_20240408.xlsx as ground-truth check on the BO-suggested formulas.
